name: Verdant Dragon - Young
description: Young Verdant is a good-leaning covenant intelligent true dragon with moss and verdigris over ancient copper scales. It seeks to restore blighted lands and pursue despoilers. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Copper Jaws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Rooted Guardian
abilities.description: While touching natural earth, the dragon cannot be knocked back.

abilities.name: Verdigris Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the target is Vulnerable while standing on the rooted ground, ending when they leave it. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
